data.other_hard: Muslim religion; above average potential for academic/research achievement; social, cultural or political involvement; enrolment or acceptance for a master's or doctorate at a German university; not eligible for part-time studies, state examinations or bachelor's degree programmes; not eligible for domestic students; residents educated in Germany cannot be funded
data.evidence_sentence: Resident educational students can’t be funded through the ISP.
data.notes: The page says the application period is closed, so the deadline is unknown; rolling is a guess from the closed period and may be wrong. Page lists both MA and doctoral funding amounts with different criteria; the program also supports imams and religious personnel. Funding amounts differ between MA and doctoral candidates. Monthly scholarship for MA 844 EUR and doctorates 1275 EUR plus supplements; stated as stipend and travel allowance. Page text lists the 'Application Requirements' as enrolment or acceptance, so applicant status is an assumption; 'Muslim' eligibility is stated in the programme description. Page is outdated in parts (references to 2018-2021 funding). Deadline field is inaccurate as the page gives no date.
